text: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid ordinary foreign passport, in good physical and mental health. 2. Sufficient financial resources; no criminal record. 3. Applicants who meet the following conditions are eligible to apply as international students: (1) Applicants who emigrated from mainland China, Hongkong, Taiwan or Macao, and have obtained a foreign nationality. (2) Applicants who acquired a foreign nationality at the time of birth, and whose parents (either or both) hold Chinese nationality (nationalities) and reside abroad. --- International applicants in the above situation must fulfill both two conditions following: ① Applicants must have held a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for more than 4 years (inclusive), which means having acquired a foreign nationality before May 1, 2022. ② Applicants must have lived outside mainland China/Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan for at least two years during the period from May 1, 2022 to April 30, 2026 (according to the entry and exit record, if the applicant has stayed outside mainland China/Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan for nine months or longer period during one year, it is equivalent to one year). 4. Age Requirements: Self-funded applicants: be at least 16 years old and under the age of 35. 5. Educational Background: have obtained a graduation certificate of higher secondary school, or its international equivalent, qualified for university entrance. 6. Language Proficiency: For English-taught programs: English proficiency must reach IELTS (Academic) 5.5 or TOEFL iBT 72. Higher scores are strongly preferred. 7. CSCA Score Report (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) For English-taught Programs: Mandatory subject is Mathematics, and it must be answered using the English test paper.
